translationRepairs: In Tiande year three (1115) a shooting stele was raised to mark the spot.
In Tiande year three (1151) a shooting stele was raised to mark the spot.
天德三年 is Tiande year three of Hailing, AD 1151, not 1115.

Shizu saw Taizu return; every petition had been granted as he wished. Delighted, he seized Taizu’s hand, drew him by the neck and caressed him, and told Muzong, “You are soft by nature, Wuyashu—only this boy can settle the Khitan business.”

Shizu saw Taizu return; every petition had been granted as he wished. Delighted, he seized Taizu’s hand, drew him by the neck and caressed him, and told Muzong, “Wuyashu is gentle and mild—only this boy can settle the Khitan business.”
烏雅束柔善 describes Wuyashu (Kangzong), not Muzong, who is the listener.
Taizu once feasted at Huoli Khan’s house in the Heishilie division. Walking outside the gate he looked south to a high knoll and had the company shoot at it; none could reach it.
Taizu once feasted at Huolihan’s house in the Heishilie division. Walking outside the gate he looked south to a high knoll and had the company shoot at it; none could reach it.
活離罕 is a single personal name, Huolihan, not a khan title.
If the enemy seizes their advantage at Mandouhe first, what good will it do us to exterminate them afterward?"
If the enemy seizes their advantage at Manduhu first, what good will it do us to exterminate them afterward?"
謾都訶 is Manduhu, as elsewhere in the chapter.
He then sent Mandouhe forty armored men.
He then sent Manduhu forty armored men.
謾都訶 is Manduhu, as elsewhere in the chapter.

He sent Boluhuo against the Dirgunen levies on the Yilan circuit, Wulugu and Alu to win over Jurchen on the Wahu and Jisai routes still on Liao rolls, and Sabudie to the Wandu circuit to arrest the Liao hawking commissioner of the Dalugu tribe, Deputy Commissioner Cilie, and the Bohai headmen at Ningjiang.

He sent Boluhuo to call up the troops of Digunai of the Yilan circuit, Wulugu and Alu to win over Jurchen on the Wahu and Jisai routes still on Liao rolls, and Sabudie to the Wandu circuit to arrest the Liao hawking official, Deputy Commissioner Cilie of the Dalugu tribe, and Dajianu, a Bohai man of Ningjiang.
迪古乃 and 大家奴 are personal names; 辭列 is the Dalugu deputy commissioner.
Then envoys from the Shili lodge of the Dalugu tribe came asking, "We hear you are marching against Liao—which side should our clan take?"
Then Shiliguan of the Dalugu tribe came asking, "We hear you are marching against Liao—which side should our clan take?"
實里館 is a personal name (Shiliguan).
Hearing this, Taizu sent Pula Ci once more to demand Ashu, but in fact to scout their strength.
Hearing this, Taizu sent Puguola once more to demand Ashu, but in fact to scout their strength.
Pula Ci reported back, "The Liao forces are vast—we could not count them."
Puguola reported back, "The Liao forces are vast—we could not count them."
Sagai sent his sons Zonghan and Wanyan Xiyin to congratulate him, hail him as emperor, and urge him to take the throne.
Sagai sent his son Zonghan and Wanyan Xiyin to congratulate him, hail him as emperor, and urge him to take the throne.
其子 applies only to 宗翰; 完顏希尹 was not a son of Sagai.
The army returned. Taizu paid respects to Empress Xuanjing, shared the booty with the clan elders, and gave the Shili lodge's estates to his troops.
The army returned. Taizu paid respects to Empress Xuanjing, shared the booty with the clan elders, and gave Shiliguan's estates to his troops.
實里館 is a personal name (Shiliguan).

He laid out the Liao's crimes before Heaven and Earth: "We served the Liao faithfully, paid tribute, put down the revolts of Wuchun and Womohan, and broke Xiao Haili's army—yet our service went unrewarded and insult was piled on insult.

He laid out the Liao's crimes before Heaven and Earth: "We served the Liao faithfully, paid tribute, put down the revolts of Wuchun and Womouhan, and broke Xiao Haili's army—yet our service went unrewarded and insult was piled on insult.
窩謀罕 is Womouhan, as earlier in the chapter.
兀惹 is the Wure people; 雛鶻室 is the personal name.
In Xizong's second year Tianjuan, Huanglong was renamed Jizhou and its garrison Lisher—the name commemorating this crossing.
In Xizong's second year Tianjuan, Huanglong was renamed Jizhou and its garrison Lishe—the name commemorating this crossing.
Laigusahuo took Kai Prefecture, Boluhuo took Telin, and Cilihan submitted.
Laigu Sahuo took Kai Prefecture, Boluhuo took Telin, and Cilihan submitted.
來穀撒喝 is a clan name plus personal name, Laigu Sahuo.
Die Boijilie Atuhan routed sixty thousand Liao troops at Zhaosan.
Die Bojilie Atuhan routed sixty thousand Liao troops at Zhaosan.
Romanization of 勃極烈 is Bojilie.
On the first of the twelfth month, gengshen, Anban Boijilie Wuqimai and the ministers invested him as Great Sage Emperor and named the coming year the first of Tianfu.
On the first of the twelfth month, gengshen, Anban Bojilie Wuqimai and the ministers invested him as Great Sage Emperor and named the coming year the first of Tianfu.
Romanization of 勃極烈 is Bojilie.
In the fourth month, Yelu Nieli, Liao prince of Qin-Jin, invaded; Digunai, Loushi, and Poluhuo led twenty thousand troops against him.
In the fourth month, Yelu Nieli, Liao prince of Qin-Jin, invaded; Digunai, Loushi, and Boluhuo led twenty thousand troops against him.
婆盧火 is Boluhuo, as elsewhere in the chapter.
He also told Cilie, bojin of the Dailigu division: "Treat every new defector with care and kindness.
He also told Cilie, bojin of the Dalugu division: "Treat every new defector with care and kindness.
On the first of the intercalary month, gengxu, the defectors Huo Shi and Han Qinghe were made wanhu.
On the first of the intercalary month, gengxu, the defectors Huo Shi and Han Qinghe were made qianhu (chiliarchs).
千戶 is a qianhu, commander of a thousand households, not a wanhu.
On guiwei in the tenth month Zhang Yinggu and Liu Zhongliang, who had surrendered from Longhua Prefecture, were made wanhu.
On guiwei in the tenth month Zhang Yinggu and Liu Zhongliang, who had surrendered from Longhua Prefecture, were made qianhu (chiliarchs).
千戶 is a qianhu, commander of a thousand households, not a wanhu.
Each was made wanhu over his own band.
Each was made qianhu (chiliarch) over his own band.
千戶 is a qianhu, not a wanhu.
Liu Hong, Liao commissioner of Yizhou, defected with three thousand households and captive Liao scouts and was made wanhu.
Liu Hong, Liao commissioner of Yizhou, defected with three thousand households and captive Liao scouts and was made qianhu (chiliarch).
千戶 is a qianhu, not a wanhu.
Tell every wanhu and mouke to search out their titles, names, and locations, record everything fully, and report upward."
Tell every qianhu and mouke to search out their titles, names, and locations, record everything fully, and report upward."
千戶 is a qianhu, not a wanhu.
On bingshen Wanhu Hulida was flogged a hundred strokes and dismissed for appointing men of his band as puliyan without authorization.
On bingshen Qianhu Hulida was flogged a hundred strokes and dismissed for appointing men of his band as puliyan without authorization.
千戶 is a qianhu, not a wanhu.
He ordered Wo Lun, administrator of the Eastern Capital, to punish future offenders in the same way.
He ordered Wolun, administrator of the Eastern Capital, to punish future offenders in the same way.
斡論 is the single personal name Wolun.
On bingchen he told Chouwo, bojin of Beyegu: "The Hulugu and Diebajie divisions have submitted; though you had quarreled before, from now on do not trouble each other."
On bingchen he told Chouwo, bojin of Biegu: "The Hulugu and Diebajie divisions have submitted; though you had quarreled before, from now on do not trouble each other."
鱉古 is Biegu, as earlier in the chapter.
In the ninth month Shiliguda and others of the Zhuzui Shui division killed Bojin Chouwo and Puhuyi and rose in rebellion.
In the ninth month Shiliguda and others of the Zhuwei River division killed Bojin Chouwo and Puhude and rose in rebellion.
